NOTE: Earnings per share above are net figures, after tax.
Optek utilized tax loss carryforwards in Q3 and first nine months of fiscal 1996 resulting in nominal income tax expense for those periods.

These carryforwards were fully utilized in Q4 of fiscal 1996; therefore, the third quarter and first nine months of fiscal 1997 reflect income tax expense on a fully taxed basis, resulting in the lower net earnings.

On an equivalent, fully taxed basis, last year's third quarter net earnings per share would have been $0.33 versus this quarter's $0.41, a 24 percent increase. Last year's first nine months net earnings per share would have been $0.84 versus this nine months $1.01, a 20 percent increase.
